page_title: NEW 1-0 BRE | Newcastle v Brentford 16/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's it for today, Craig Pawson has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+11' A quickly taken corner by Newcastle.
90+10' Newcastle quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+9' Newcastle take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) was quite harsh and Craig Pawson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+5' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90+5' The referee shows a yellow card to Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.

90+4' What an opportunity! Yoane Wissa (Brentford) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the resulting free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
90+3' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
88' Brentford have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
87' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
85' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
83' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Harvey Barnes is replaced by Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd).
82' It is time for a substitution. Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) is on for Aaron Hickey.
81' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Newcastle! Play can continue.
81' Referee Craig Pawson makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
81' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
78' Kevin Schade (Brentford) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner, but Nick Pope makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
75' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Newcastle comes to nothing.
75' The corner is swung in but Newcastle can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Newcastle are going to take it.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Christian Norgaard trots off the pitch and is replaced by Frank Onyeka (Brentford).
72' Thomas Frank has decided to substitute Vitaly Janelt and he is replaced by Kevin Schade (Brentford).
72' Substitution. Ben Mee leaves the pitch and is replaced by Neal Maupay (Brentford).
68' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) makes a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Mark Flekken (Brentford) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
64' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) into the top right hand corner, giving goalkeeper Mark Flekken no chance!
64' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

63' Mark Flekken (Brentford) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Craig Pawson with no other option than to blow for a foul. Newcastle are about to take a penalty!
59' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Aaron Hickey (Brentford) for his blatant foul.
57' The Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Craig Pawson rules it out for a foul.
53' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) sends a long ball forward to Anthony Gordon, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
53' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
51' A cross by Yoane Wissa (Brentford) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
50' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked.
47' Great teamplay by Newcastle as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' A great solo run by Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the top of the net was easily caught by Mark Flekken.
45+4' A raking crossfield pass from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
45+3' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
45+2' Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
45+2' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
42' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Craig Pawson had an easy-decision to make.
42' Thomas Frank is forced to make a change. Rico Henry (Brentford) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Mads Roerslev Rasmussen.
39' Rico Henry (Brentford) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
39' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
38' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
37' The corner kick from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
37' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes a short free kick.
36' Ben Mee (Brentford) brings his opponent down. Craig Pawson has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
34' The game is interrupted now, Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
33' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) has tested the patience of referee Craig Pawson and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
29' Newcastle can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
28' A header by Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) from very close range goes towards the bottom left corner, but doesn't get past Mark Flekken, who makes a brilliant save.
28' Corner kick. Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is ready to send the ball into the box.
25' Craig Pawson blows his whistle after Yoane Wissa (Brentford) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
23' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brentford.
23' An attempted cross from Aaron Hickey (Brentford) is cleared. Brentford get a corner.
22' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
20' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman signals a throw-in for Newcastle.
20' The Newcastle players are exchanging some short passes.
18' Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
15' Aaron Hickey (Brentford) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
14' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
12' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
11' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
10' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
10' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) makes a slide tackle, but referee Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
6' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
6' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Newcastle.
1' The ball is cleared after Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Newcastle will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Craig Pawson.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
